description:
Submit a provider version for review

Submits a draft or rejected version for admin review, the way a PUBLIC provider's versions go live. On a PRIVATE provider use publish_provider_version instead — those need no review.

body.description: Body for submitting a provider version for review. Transitions the version's branch from `draft` (or `rejected`) to `in_review`.

notes.description: Optional note from the author to reviewers (changelog, areas to focus on, and so on).

name: submit_provider_version_for_review
